# Swim Times

> When can I swim today? Public swimming times at public pools in Berlin and Munich and Frankfurt and Cologne and Dresden and Leipzig and Zurich and Vienna and Sacramento and Bay Area and London, for today and the next 6 days, refreshed daily from the pool operators' websites. German and English; the US cities in English.

Each pool page states, per day, when the pool is open for public swimming and, where the operator publishes it, whether the whole pool or only part of it is available (Berlin) or how many lanes are booked by schools and clubs (Munich). The operators' websites are authoritative.
